description: This file provides a local storage service for offline note persistence, including CRUD operations for notes stored in browser localStorage.

methods.name: getNotesFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from localStorage, returning an array of note objects.

methods.name: saveNoteToStorage
methods.description: Saves a new note object to localStorage, generating an ID and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNoteFromStorage
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from localStorage.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for notes.
